name: High-dose CARBOplatin / Etoposide + autologous stem-cell rescue (HDCT)
cyclesNote: Typically given as tandem/sequential high-dose cycles (commonly 2 to 3), each followed by autologous peripheral-blood stem-cell reinfusion

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - salvage (high-dose chemotherapy)

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: High-dose CARBOplatin plus etoposide with autologous stem-cell rescue is a myeloablative salvage strategy for relapsed or platinum-refractory germ cell tumor, delivered only at an experienced transplant/germ-cell centre with harvested peripheral-blood stem cells. Serum tumor markers track response. Dose and schedule in our own words for a DRAFT decision-support tool; the exact per-cycle CARBOplatin AUC target, number of cycles, and stem-cell logistics are set by the treating transplant protocol.

histology: germ cell tumor (seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor / NSGCT), relapsed or platinum-refractory

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis (high emetic risk)
premedications.notes: High-dose CARBOplatin/etoposide is highly emetogenic; give guideline-based multi-agent prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: Autologous peripheral-blood stem cells must be harvested before high-dose therapy and reinfused after each myeloablative cycle.
Prolonged pancytopenia expected: neutropenic precautions, transfusion support, and G-CSF per transplant protocol.
Infection prophylaxis (antibacterial/antiviral/antifungal) and close inpatient monitoring during aplasia.
AUC dosing: compute high-dose CARBOplatin from measured/estimated GFR (Calvert); verify renal function before each cycle.
monitoring: Serum tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG, LDH) before each cycle and at restaging
CBC daily through the aplastic phase - deep and prolonged myelosuppression
Renal function and GFR before each cycle - required for AUC (Calvert) dosing
Audiometry and neurologic assessment - cumulative platinum ototoxicity/neuropathy
clearanceChecks: renal function / GFR for AUC dosing

doseModificationRules.text: Recalculate the AUC-based high-dose CARBOplatin from current GFR (Calvert). Physician/transplant protocol decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: failure of count recovery or organ toxicity between cycles
doseModificationRules.text: Review required before the next high-dose cycle; delay or reassess suitability for further myeloablative therapy. Physician decides.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: High-dose CARBOplatin dosed to target approximately AUC 7 to 8 per day (Calvert formula, not mg/m2) on Days 1 to 3 of each myeloablative cycle. Tall-man per ISMP. Exact AUC target set by the transplant protocol; dose and schedule in our own words from standard high-dose salvage practice (general references NCCN/DeVita).

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: High-dose etoposide 750 mg/m2 IV on Days 1 to 3 of each myeloablative cycle, paired with high-dose CARBOplatin and followed by autologous stem-cell reinfusion. Dose and schedule in our own words from standard high-dose salvage practice (general references NCCN/DeVita).
